content:
Maya: FYI we saw sporadic failures for some onboarding uploads in the 11:03-11:12 UTC window. Early list includes: NovaTrial-3, RetailBeta-5, EduStarter-12. Putting together comms; Linh can you triage renewals?

SRE-Sam: Root cause prelim: a writeservice restart coincided with a schema validation change causing a small fraction of documents to be rejected. We reverted the schema change at 11:10 UTC and kicked a priority re-index job. Queue is at ~60% processed.

incident-bot: ticket created INC-2026-177. reindex job id: rjob-20260330-17.

Linh (CS): Thanks. For accounts with renewals in next 30 days (RetailBeta-5) mark high-touch. Drafting two variants of external text: one short for trials and a high-touch for renewal accounts. Avoid technical details externally.

Tom (AE): For RetailBeta-5 please include an option for a 2-week premium trial or a one-time invoice credit. Renewal is in 11 days; prefer premium trial + named AE handoff.

Maya: Draft trial message (short):
"Hi <Name>, we experienced brief upload interruptions between 11:03-11:12 UTC that may have affected some imports. We've reverted the change and are re-processing pending items now; most customers will see completion within the hour. We're sorry for the trouble. If you'd like a walkthrough we can schedule a 90-minute recovery session at no cost, or prioritize manual re-imports on request."

Linh (CS): Draft renewal/high-touch message:
"Hi <Name>, apologies  we prioritized your account after an upload issue earlier today and retried pending items. To ensure no data was lost we'd like to offer a two-week complimentary premium tier and a 1:1 technical review with our SRE (Sam) and your AE (Tom). Reply with a preferred time and whether you want the premium trial or a billing credit."

Maya: Internal root-cause note for RCA: schema validation change deployed without canary gating; reverted. Action items: add canary gate, add end-to-end ingest test, and include a post-deploy verification job for schema flips. Keep short line for customers: "we reverted a recent internal change and reprocessed pending uploads."

Tom (AE): Please add billing tag "incident-1918887777-credit" so finance can track any credits or trials. I'll take RetailBeta-5 outreach and be CC'd.

SRE-Sam: Reindex job is at 92% and success rate on retries is 99.6%. Will attach logs to INC-2026-177 and a short postmortem once tests and the diff are ready. Plan to add a smoke test that replays a small sample of customer payloads on schema changes.

Linh (CS): I'll send the high-touch note to RetailBeta-5 now and broadcast the trial message to smaller accounts in 20m after we confirm queue drain. We'll collect responses in the CS tracker and summarize feedback into the RCA.

Maya: Also opening two recovery office-hours slots: Thu 14:00 PT and Fri 08:00 CET. Booking link: https://cal.redwood/recovery-office. Include booking link in outbound messages.

incident-bot: confluence doc created: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-177/summary

Tom (AE): DMing Linh the concession details. I'll join the office hours for RetailBeta-5 if they book.

Linh (CS): Sending now. Will log replies and escalate any request for manual re-import to SRE-Sam. Update execs with a 1-paragraph summary by EOD. :thumbsup:
